nc.description: A light grey 3D model depicts a structure with a sphere hanging inside a vertical column and a large, rounded block resting on an attached angled arm.
A grey mechanical device with a crank handle and a protruding rod contains white, block-like shapes positioned next to cylindrical components within its central housing.
A close-up view displays a static, light grey 3D-rendered mechanical assembly featuring a prominent dial, a cylindrical roller, and blocky supports resting on a flat surface.

A 3D rendering depicts a grey, abstract mechanical structure with multiple cylindrical rods extending to the left, an articulated arm reaching to the right, and a white teardrop shape hanging from its central block.
An assortment of uniform, light grey structural components and geometric shapes is arranged symmetrically around a central circular hub on a white surface.

vc.description: A close-up view displays a grey model of a mechanical wheel assembly featuring a metallic central hub, suspension linkages, and treaded tires.
A monochromatic mechanical assembly features a bicycle pedal linked by a chain to a central gear system and a textured handle.
A grey 3D render shows a mechanical assembly where a studded belt wraps around a gear attached to a linear rail, resting on a textured, uneven surface.
A monochromatic 3D rendering shows motorcycle handlebars with hands sculpted directly into the grips and levers, positioned next to an isolated mechanical linkage.
Various light-colored metal mechanical components, including welded tubular frames, ribbed plates, fasteners, and a central bearing hub, are arranged symmetrically on a white surface.
